intent.raw: Use DomainSpec to design everything necessary for the Poker Agent Arena MVP.
intent.objective: Run the canonical Refine loop over the Poker Agent Arena project to produce a non-executed Local Arena CLI v0 DomainSpec design and implementation plan.
intent.operator_sentence: use domain spec to design all necessary for doing mvp of this

route_menu.context_hint: The project can cut the first executable route several ways; refinement should select a bounded route before task-session work starts.

items.label: Local Arena CLI v0
items.description: Build the first local CLI arena proof with protocol, runner, transcript, replay, diagnostics, sample agents, and a Kuhn fixture gate.

items.label: Two-Fixture Arena CLI v0
items.description: Build Kuhn and Leduc into the first executable route, increasing validation coverage at higher implementation cost.

items.label: Hold'em Engine CLI v1
items.description: Select or wrap a Hold'em engine before toy fixtures prove the Local Arena CLI v0 protocol.

items.label: Leaderboard Diagnostics v2
items.description: Prioritize adjusted scoring and competitive presentation before calibration fixtures.

technique_overlays.trigger: Refine requires the canonical ten-stage sequence with native receipt handoffs.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage records a native receipt or explicit blocked reason; final synthesis consumes stage evidence.

technique_overlays.trigger: The first executable route could mean contract-only, one-fixture runtime, two-fixture runtime, Hold'em first, or leaderboard first.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The run must select one MVP cut and preserve rejected alternatives with reasons.

technique_overlays.trigger: Local Arena CLI v0 must balance competitive feel, implementation cost, hidden-information safety, replay proof, and future Hold'em compatibility.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Critique stages must preserve tension between minimality and compelling competition until synthesis.

technique_overlays.trigger: The current docs name major concepts, but Local Arena CLI v0 still needs module boundaries, interfaces, artifact ownership, and CLI command shape.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Design output must expose the minimum component catalog for runner, protocol, referee, transcript, replay, fixtures, CLI, and diagnostics.

technique_overlays.trigger: Local Arena CLI v0 should be falsified through a Kuhn fixture gate first, with Leduc board reveal staged before Hold'em integration.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The plan must name toy fixtures, abuse agents, golden transcripts, and failure interpretations.

technique_overlays.trigger: Prior dispatch, invoke, refine, refresh, and whisper artifacts already define constraints and should be reused without silently becoming implementation proof.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Existing evidence informs the MVP but does not count as runtime completion.

technique_overlays.trigger: The project lives in a private umbrella repo with public/private submodule boundaries.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The route must keep public docs, generated refinement evidence, future runtime code, private validation, and observability state separate.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The first executable route has several plausible cuts and needs role-bound pressure before a future task-session starts building runtime code.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Four sibling roles can independently pressure-test scope, architecture, validation, and agent-author experience while parent Refine owns final synthesis.
context: Existing artifacts are strong but still planning and documentation surfaces.
The current next route is SWU-PAA-001R before runtime implementation.
The MVP must avoid slipping into full Hold'em, hosted tournaments, or composite leaderboard claims.
The docs deliberately create human/product and engineer/agent views that must remain distinct.

roles.purpose: Cut the smallest credible MVP and reject tempting but premature scope.
roles.owns: route boundary critique, rejected alternatives, and minimum acceptance list.

roles.purpose: Map the runtime modules, file tree, interfaces, and CLI command surface needed for the selected route.
roles.owns: Architecture x-ray receipt and component/interface gap list.

roles.purpose: Attack the MVP through toy fixtures, hidden-information leaks, invalid-output abuse, fallback strategy, and replay determinism.
roles.owns: Fixture falsification receipt and validation gate recommendations.

roles.purpose: Check whether a first agent author can understand, run, and debug the MVP without reading all internal artifacts.
roles.owns: Developer-experience receipt and first-run documentation requirements.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if root docs, spec, design, or work-pack cannot be resolved

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: block if define treats MVP as full Hold'em, hosted tournament, real-money play, or final leaderboard

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: scope residue is named instead of hidden
stop_conditions: block if MVP boundary cannot distinguish useful local runtime from docs-only planning

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: ask before external research if a named engine/library/comparison gap appears

steps.name: Distill MVP unit
convergence_criteria: selected route is buildable in small SWUs
Local Arena CLI v0 recomposes into later Leduc and Hold'em paths
rejected alternatives preserve their future route
stop_conditions: block if no selected route unit can be validated by toy fixtures

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design
stop_conditions: block if design lacks runner, protocol, referee, transcript, replay, fixture, CLI, and diagnostics boundaries

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: architecture has enough detail for task-session
fixture plan can falsify hidden-information leaks and fallback abuse
developer experience does not require undocumented assumptions
stop_conditions: block if design is too vague for SWU planning

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block if the repaired MVP cannot be validated by local fixtures

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: block if the plan lacks SWUs, validation checks, or a first executable route

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: block if final synthesis claims runtime completion or executes task-session work

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates before runtime-backed stage execution.
Operator confirms the route and approved subagent strategy before runtime execution.
Every runtime-backed stage records a native stage receipt or explicit blocked reason.
MVP plan excludes full Hold'em, hosted public matchmaking, real-money play, and composite leaderboard scoring.
Refine does not claim task-session execution, Inventory/Ontology promotion, or public Arcanum mutation.
External research runs only if a named gap appears and the operator confirms the bounded pass.
If subagents are spawned after approval, every spawned subagent has terminal join and close state before final synthesis.
Final synthesis consumes stage evidence and records residues, rejected alternatives, and recommended next routes.

boundaries.contract: Refine may recommend task-session and prepare a work-pack, but it must not execute MVP implementation.
Refine writes generated evidence under the poker project only and does not mutate public Arcanum or private validation submodules.
RULES.md remains human/product-facing while AGENT-RULES.md remains engineer/agent-facing.

authority.lifecycle: refine owns this Local Arena CLI v0 design refinement run
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validates route shape; future task-session validates runtime behavior
authority.evidence: stage capabilities own their artifacts; refine indexes them
authority.memory: memory may inform context but cannot promote project knowledge
authority.promotion: no Inventory/Ontology/glossary/sigil/spell promotion in this run

state_namespaces.write_policy: blocked in this refine strategy and only allowed after task-session route approval

promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review; does not automatically promote

promotion_guardrails: Do not execute task-session work inside Refine.
Do not promote Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell knowledge.
Do not mutate public Arcanum or private validation submodules.
Do not convert docs or plans into runtime completion proof.
